messages.subject: Incorporating uncertainty with useAmbiguities
parts:
Hi Nick

I've been playing around with incorporating fossils into BioGeoBEARS analyses by coding areas with uncertain data as "?" The data from my tip ranges file imports fine when the question marks are included, and I can use the tipranges_to_tip_condlikes_of_data_on_each_state function to get a tip likelihood object.

However I was wondering if you could give me specific instructions on how to actually run an analysis with this data. When I try to include the geogfn file with question marks in the analysis, it tells me off, saying "error in rowSums(defnums_to_numeric(tipranges_df_tmp): 'x' must be numeric"

Thanks
Neil
